answer_1.quote: Given a medical image x and a user query q, model generates a response a token‑by‑token. The response includes the diagnosis and a description of the abnormal region...
answer_1.outputs: Textual diagnosis with abnormality description and bounding‑box coordinates

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our method on five benchmarks: test set of our MAU, VQA‑RAD and SLAKE, PMC‑VQA‑test and MedMNIST... The localization reward is based on IoU between predicted and ground‑truth boxes...
